source.title_or_context: The following list of medications may include one or more prescriptions from your doctor. Medication adherence is important to treat heart failure. Use this list to better understand your possible medications.

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Isolated medication fact table. Ten rows are descriptive; the ivabradine row also contains one explicit permissive prescribing statement, which is separated from its factual effect annotation.
